model: company-as-tenant (SPEC §1). company_id is the boundary; floors are visual only.

features.title: Hermetic flake-parts setup with devShell and treefmt
features.description: flake.nix evaluates cleanly, exposes devShells, treefmt checks, NixOS module, and packages (backend/frontend/default).
features.note: Flake, pkgs, module, and treefmt config exist and are written; Nix could not be executed in this sandbox, so nix flake check / nix fmt are deferred to CI.

features.title: 16x16 orthogonal pixel art tileset and character sprites
features.description: Staged 16x16 LimeZu Modern Interiors master sheets and character spritesheets in frontend/static/assets/.

features.title: Dual-screen layout shell
features.description: SvelteKit layout rendering Top Screen (320x240 canvas, pixelated) and Bottom Screen (Poketch console).
features.note: Frontend SPA built and served by the backend; 60fps is a target, not benchmarked in sandbox.

features.title: 1F Reception onboarding wizard
features.description: Interactive multiple-choice questionnaire with 4 grilling intensity tiers; creates a company tenant.

features.title: SSE company state event bus
features.description: FastAPI endpoint streaming agent/task/approval deltas via SSE, scoped per company_id.
acceptance_criteria: subscribers only receive their own company's events

features.title: Kanban DAG & WIP persistence
features.description: SQLite schema for append-only event log, Kanban/task DAG with WIP limits, artifacts, approvals (SPEC §9.4).
acceptance_criteria: WIP limit enforcement (default 3 IN_PROGRESS per team)

features.title: HR coordinator provisioning
features.description: HR Coordinator creates/assigns/pauses/retires workers, assigns desks, models, token budgets, and capabilities after policy/budget checks.
acceptance_criteria: request_hire -> PENDING approval -> execute_hire creates worker
desk occupancy updates in state stream

features.title: Hardened NixOS service module
features.description: services.polyfloor NixOS module with DynamicUser and systemd security sandboxing; nixosModules.default importable downstream.
features.verified: module exists and is hardened; nixosModules.default wired in modules/flake-module.nix. Not nix-evaluated in this sandbox.

features.title: OpenAI-compatible model router
features.description: Model router client to POLYFLOOR_ROUTER_ENDPOINT (Kong/Extreme Router/LiteLLM /v1). GET /api/models enumerates and groups free|fast|reasoning|frontier; PUT /api/agents/{id}/model changes an agent's model at runtime.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/models returns grouped catalog with _source live|mock
PUT /api/agents/{id}/model is company-scoped (404 if not in company)

features.title: Dynamic avatar composer
features.description: backend/assets/avatar_composer.py (Pillow) composes per-agent avatars from allowlisted LimeZu generator parts with a deterministic company/agent seed; rejects arbitrary paths/URLs; role->staged fallback.

features.title: Digital-products bootstrap pipeline
features.description: Creating a company materializes CEO + HR + c-suite + team leads + rooms + desks + the gated research->spec->draft->QA->marketing->publish pipeline + a publish approval.
acceptance_criteria: digital-products template wires the production line

features.title: Tenant isolation tests
features.description: company_id on every record; queries/writes filter by company_id; two companies cannot see each other's data.
acceptance_criteria: every object in /state snapshot carries company_id

features.title: Observability endpoints
features.description: GET /healthz -> {status: ok}; GET /metrics -> Prometheus text; structured logs with company_id, trace_id, task_id, agent_id.
features.verified: routers/health.py + observability.py present; exercised via test_api

features.title: NFP integration (import flake module)
features.description: NFP layers/70-agents/76-orchestrators/polyfloor.nix imports inputs.polyfloor.nixosModules.default, points routerEndpoint at the NFP LLM router, sets defaultHrModel=mimo-v2.5-pro, and wires sops environmentFile.
features.verified: module rewritten; not nix-evaluated in this sandbox. /v1/models enumerable via 78-llm-routers Kong route.
